description: This file is a JavaScript library implementing QR code generation, including classes for QR code symbols and data segments, functions for encoding data, and error correction algorithms.

classes.name: QrCode
classes.description: Represents an immutable QR code symbol with methods for rendering and data access.

classes.name: QrSegment
classes.description: Represents a data segment to be encoded in a QR code, with static methods for creating segments in various modes.

classes.name: Ecc
classes.description: Enumeration of error correction levels for QR codes.

classes.name: Mode
classes.description: Represents the mode of a data segment, such as numeric, alphanumeric, byte, etc.

classes.name: ReedSolomonGenerator
classes.description: Computes Reed-Solomon error correction codewords for data blocks.

classes.name: BitBuffer
classes.description: A helper class for constructing a sequence of bits for encoding.

methods.name: encodeText
methods.description: Encodes a Unicode string into a QR code with specified error correction level.

methods.name: encodeBinary
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a QR code with specified error correction level.

methods.name: encodeSegments
methods.description: Encodes data segments with custom modes and parameters into a QR code.

methods.name: makeBytes
methods.description: Creates a data segment from a byte array.

methods.name: makeNumeric
methods.description: Creates a numeric mode data segment from a string of digits.

methods.name: makeAlphanumeric
methods.description: Creates an alphanumeric mode data segment from a string.

methods.name: makeSegments
methods.description: Creates data segments from a Unicode string, optimizing mode switches.

methods.name: makeEci
methods.description: Creates a data segment for Extended Channel Interpretation (ECI).
